name: cog-second-brain
description: Self-evolving second brain with 31 AI skills, 10 agents, and people CRM. Closed-loop harness release: V-model verification lifecycle with criterion-traced evidence, read-only verifier agents, risk lanes, multi-session ultragoals with a north-star acceptance gate, and craft skills for writing and visuals. Inspired by Garry Tan's gstack and gbrain, and dwarves-kit. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro, Gemini CLI, Codex.
